$$

首先计算floor(200/3)，也就是200除以3等于66.666...，取整数部分是66。接下来是3^2=9，floor(200/9)=floor(22.222...)等于22。然后是3^3=27，floor(200/27)=floor(7.407...)等于7。接下来是3^4=81，floor(200/81)=floor(2.469...)等于2。再下一个是3^5=243，这时候200除以243是小于1的，所以floor结果是0。这时候就可以停止了，因为后面的项都是0。

The greatest positive integer $ n $ such that $ 3^n $ is a factor of $ 200! $ is found by summing the integer divisions of $ 200 $ by powers of 3 until the division result is zero. 

$$
\left\lfloor \frac{200}{3} \right\rfloor + \left\lfloor \frac{200}{9} \right\rfloor + \left\lfloor \frac{200}{27} \right\rfloor + \left\lfloor \frac{200}{81} \right\rfloor = 66 + 22 + 7 + 2 = 97
$$

$$
\boxed{97}
$$
